_doc: USD per 1M tokens. Opus uses Claude Code's own total_cost_usd and GLM-5.3 the Z.ai list price; the other rows are list-price estimates from third-party trackers (see source). They are what the same tokens would cost on the public API, not what was paid: Alibaba, Azure and OpenAI runs used plans or credits. Edit and re-run bin/export.py.

gpt-6.1-sol.source: OpenAI standard rate as reported by price trackers (requesty.ai, anotherwrapper.com); third-party price tracker, checked 2026-10-13; estimate, not an invoice

qwen3.7-plus.source: <=256K tier as listed by opencode.ai and Fireworks; Alibaba-attributed figures range 0.32-0.50 in, 1.28-3.00 out; third-party price tracker, checked 2026-10-13; estimate, not an invoice

kimi-k2.5.source: Moonshot rate as reported by aggregators (output 2.50-3.00, cache read 0.07-0.20 by source); third-party price tracker, checked 2026-10-13; estimate, not an invoice

MiniMax-M2.5.source: MiniMax rate as reported by aggregators; cache read from artificialanalysis.ai; third-party price tracker, checked 2026-10-13; estimate, not an invoice

glm-5.source: Z.ai rate as reported by anotherwrapper.com; cache read not published, assumed at the GLM-5.x ratio (0.26/1.40); third-party price tracker, checked 2026-10-13; estimate, not an invoice

gpt-6-luna.source: OpenAI standard rate as reported by price trackers (openrouter.ai, digitalapplied.com); third-party price tracker, checked 2026-10-13; estimate, not an invoice

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next.source: QwenCloud list price of the hosted qwen3.8-flash as reported by the-decoder.com, a third-party report (0.15-0.16 in by source); the round-4 runs used a local server, so this is what the same tokens would cost hosted, not what was paid; no cache-read price, all input at the input rate; checked 2026-10-23; estimate, not an invoice

anthropic.source: Claude Max 20x (Claude Code login); 5-hour and weekly usage windows

zai.source: GLM Coding Max (approx.); prompts per 5-hour window and per week

alibaba.source: Alibaba Coding Plan Pro: ~$50/mo, up to 90,000 requests/month

azure.source: pay per token from cloud credits (Sol 6.1 agent runs)
